svg.text: Incomplete pinAttributes: one warning for the chip
EMPTY is empty; COLOR_ONLY has no electrical role.
FALSE_ONLY enables no role; MISSING is omitted.
Four affected pins share ONE warning: THREE examples + 'and 1 more'.
SUPPLY, INPUT, GROUND and the intentional NC pin are valid.
Chip U1 has pinAttributes issues affecting 4 pins: EMPTY (missing
electrical role in pinAttributes), COLOR_ONLY (missing electrical role
in pinAttributes), FALSE_ONLY (missing electrical role in
pinAttributes), and 1 more. Specify an electrical role for each pin
